import os
d='/home/ubuntu/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
open(d+'/task-0056fcb9.py','w').write('''
def transform(grid):
    bg = 8
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c] != bg]
    if not pts:
        return g
    rs = [p[0] for p in pts]; cs = [p[1] for p in pts]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c] == bg and ((r in (r0, r1) and c0 <= c <= c1) or (c in (c0, c1) and r0 <= r <= r1)):
                g[r][c] = 2
    return g
''')
